decisions: Separate Coinbase recognized lending collateral, derivatives collateral, customer collateral not recognized as an asset, and crypto assets borrowed. Never sum these as one Coinbase-owned capital pool.

Do not claim Coinbase has a material XRP collateral position from the Q3 2026 10-Q. The derivatives collateral table names BTC and ETH only; the lending 'other crypto' line is $9.903M total with no token breakdown.

Treat Circle's $36T H1/$77% June USDC volume statement as a company claim. Keep Visa/Allium adjusted volume as a separate dataset; do not reconcile until coverage, filters, chain scope and transaction classification are aligned.
Treat Circle's $655.3M H1 Coinbase distribution cost as part of the $815.816M distribution-and-transaction cost line. The derived 80.3% ratio is not a pure partner payout share.
Keep Coinbase's USDC rewards expense separate from Circle's distribution costs; both represent different sides of stablecoin distribution economics.
Keep ETF flow trackers separate by fund universe and settlement cutoff; no single aggregate or prediction feature until fund-level crosswalk is complete.
Keep TradRadar multi-venue derivatives observations timestamped and provider-scoped; account long/short ratios are not notional positioning and liquidation totals are minimums.
Keep Binance's Binance14 EVM PoR finding separate from the five XRPL source wallets. Do not infer an XRP reserve shortfall without the official XRP address crosswalk.
rationale: Coinbase Q3 SEC collateral tables are the strongest current public evidence for its lending/derivatives collateral structure.
Circle Q2 SEC financials and October 16 company blog allow cross-checking partner distribution costs and reserve-yield sensitivity.
Visa/Allium adjusted transaction methodology provides an independent methodological counterweight to issuer-reported raw volume claims.
XRP ETF and derivatives observations are asynchronous and provider-dependent; admitting them prematurely risks leakage and universe mismatch.
next_action: Build a historical feature store with separate provider/definition identifiers; reconcile the five Binance XRPL source wallets to the October 1 PoR address set; complete ETF fund-universe crosswalk; collect synchronized XRP spot/perpetual book depth, funding and liquidation data; ingest Circle Q3 results on 2026-11-04.
